test_item:
DebugAuth should compare "ECUId" from the received configuration to its own SSN (security serial number)
(head unit serial number is the same as the ECUId parameter)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. SAM dongle is inserted into the DUT
proc:
1. Read /sys/devices/soc0/serial_number on the DUT
$ adb shell cat /sys/devices/soc0/serial_number
2. <DUT-side trigger for SAM AuthData package issued for this serial number provided by RD (X-g)>
$ <command provided by RD (X-g)>
3. Confirm the dauth log after the previous step
$ adb logcat -s dauth
er:
1. The adb shell cat /sys/devices/soc0/serial_number output shows the head unit serial number
2. <observable outcome provided by RD (X-g)>
3. The adb logcat -s dauth output contains the serial number match entry
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
